routing_warnings.description: The requirement to integrate US, Indian, and other international differences into the checklist and wider manuscript belongs to the independent global-perspective Requirement.

The originality failure, AI-workflow residue, and impermissible AI-use evidence belong to the manuscript-originality Requirement; only the resulting project termination supports removal of this target Requirement.
The originality failure and AI-workflow evidence belong to the manuscript-originality Requirement; only the explicit decision to end the entire project supports REMOVE for this target chapter.

The originality violation, AI-workflow residue, nonexistent reference, and milestone rejection are execution evidence for the manuscript-originality Requirement; only the explicit project termination supports the REMOVE Event for this target.

The instruction to make proposed deletions in the shared Google Doc using suggesting mode belongs to the authoritative editing workflow; only the target-specific rationale requirement is retained here.
The clauses about merging, removing, or introducing whole categories and chapters concern category-level structure rather than individual-question curation.
The requirement for editorial review before proposed additions or removals are implemented belongs to the independent editorial approval gate.

The authoritative Google Doc, suggestion-mode, and reference-PDF instructions concern the manuscript editing workflow; the question-removal and addition expectation is retained under the target Requirement.

The originality violation and AI-workflow residue are execution evidence for the originality and permitted-AI-use Requirement; only the explicit decision to end the project supports the target Requirement's removal.
The instruction to remove or add individual questions concerns question-level curation and does not establish a category or chapter restructuring change.

The reported AI-workflow residue, detection results, and originality failure are execution evidence for the manuscript originality and permitted-AI-use Requirement, not for category-structure curation.
This message establishes the authoritative editing location and suggestion-mode workflow rather than changing the editorial approval gate.
The rejection evidence concerns manuscript originality and permitted AI assistance rather than the editorial approval gate.
The video exception establishes script delivery while assigning recording to the editorial team and should be handled under the video-script Requirement.
The requirement to prepare templates sufficiently for precise production belongs to the separate production-ready template Requirement.
The discrepancy raised here concerns the agreement’s authored-material word count, not a change to the established 110,000-word complete-book ceiling.
The client’s correction to 24,000 words changes the contracted revision word count rather than the complete-book ceiling.

The originality findings and rejected deliverables provide runtime-failure evidence for the originality and permitted-AI-use Requirement; only the project-termination clause supports removal of the target Requirement.
The requirement that proposed additions and removals await editorial review concerns the separate editorial-approval gate rather than the manuscript editing artifact or recording method.

The rejected submission, AI-workflow residue, and nonexistent manuscript reference are evidence about originality and permitted AI assistance, not a demonstrated failure of the authoritative Google Doc editing workflow.
